# LocalCloud

> LocalCloud is a local Google Cloud runtime for development, testing, CI, and demos. It runs 20+ GCP service surfaces in one Docker container, uses standard Google Cloud SDKs pointed at localhost, and requires no GCP account, credentials, service-account keys, or billing project by default.

LocalCloud is not a production replacement for Google Cloud. Validate against real GCP before production deployment.
Availability: Free for developers.

## Primary docs

- [AI agent guide](https://local.cloud/ai/): Human explanation, copy prompts, service matrix, safety boundaries, and AGENTS.md template for AI coding agents.
- [Raw agent execution guide](https://local.cloud/ai/agents.md): Markdown instructions for agents to start LocalCloud and verify localhost GCP workflows safely.
- [AGENTS.md template](https://local.cloud/ai/AGENTS.md): Downloadable repository-local agent policy template.
- [Agent Markdown resources](https://local.cloud/ai/resources.md): Raw Markdown route index and canonical policy for agent-facing alternatives.
- [Agent service matrix](https://local.cloud/ai/services.md): Raw Markdown service metadata for agents.
- [Agent compatibility boundaries](https://local.cloud/ai/compatibility.md): Raw Markdown safety and validation rules.
- [Agent docs index](https://local.cloud/ai/docs.md): Raw Markdown setup, SDK, Terraform, and seed-data links.
- [LocalCloud Agent Skills](https://github.com/LocalGCloud/LocalGCloud.github.io/tree/main/agent-skills): Portable skills for BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Terraform, CI sidecars, seed data, and SDK tests; copy `agent-skills/skills/*` into `.agents/skills/`.
- [Getting started](https://local.cloud/docs/): Quick start for running LocalCloud locally.
- [Service catalog](https://local.cloud/services/): 20+ local GCP service surfaces with ports, protocols, and coverage notes.
- [Compatibility and limitations](https://local.cloud/compatibility/): Boundaries and known limitations for local validation.
- [SDK examples](https://local.cloud/docs/sdk-examples/): Configure standard Google Cloud SDKs to use localhost emulator endpoints.
- [Terraform integration](https://local.cloud/docs/terraform/): Endpoint overrides for local Terraform validation.
- [Seed data](https://local.cloud/docs/seed-data/): Repeatable local data setup.

## Key facts

- Docker image: `jaysen2apache/localcloud`
- Web console: `http://localhost:24080`
- Health endpoint: `http://localhost:24080/_localcloud/health`
- Shell env endpoint: `http://localhost:24080/_localcloud/env?format=shell`
- Terraform env endpoint: `http://localhost:24080/_localcloud/env?format=terraform`
- Quick start:

```bash
docker pull jaysen2apache/localcloud
docker run -d -p 8080:24080 -p 4443:24081 -p 8085-8087:24082-8087 \
  -p 9010:24085 -p 9020:24086 -p 9050:24087 -p 9060:24088 -p 6379:6379 \
  -m 4g --name localcloud \
  -v ~/.localcloud/data:/var/lib/localcloud \
  jaysen2apache/localcloud
eval "$(curl -s http://localhost:24080/_localcloud/env?format=shell)"
```
